name: Persona Driver Reiki
original_name: ペルソナドライバー 霊姫
source:
In the summer of 200X, many witness information on mythical monsters is reported. The conspiracy schemed by multinational company, "Haryu Industry".... Miki, whose father developed "G Persona", stands up to become "Persona Driver Reiki" and destroy their ambition!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302131553/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1004592]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
200X年的夏天，有关神话怪物的目击报告层出不穷。这是跨国企业“波流产业”策划的阴谋……父亲开发出“G Persona”的神代美姬挺身而出，化身“Persona Driver灵姬”，誓要粉碎他们的野心！

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090302131553/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1004592]Eroge Shop[/url]]
